overloads.semanticRole: Sets declaration options (character-set encoding and whether the tree is standalone) for the XML tree rooted at elementRef.

constraints: encoding defaults to UTF-8 if the command is not called, or if an unsupported character set is passed.
standalone defaults to False (not standalone) if omitted or if the command is not called.
indentation is kept only for compatibility with pre-v12 databases; it is not recommended, and XML SET OPTIONS should be used instead to control document indentation.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close
